title: add offline distro image-indexing + delta snapshot tooling for safe on-prem upgrades
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: customers running air-gapped/private deployments require deterministic offline upgrade artifacts and a compact index that maps distro variants and kube runtimes to vendored OCI images. This PR adds a stand-alone image indexer and delta snapshot generator to the offline installer toolchain so operators can produce minimal upgrade bundles and validated rollback snapshots without access to public registries. Summary: implements an image indexing service (cli and library), a delta snapshot format (signed manifest + OCI manifest refs), Helm chart changes to consume indexed manifests at install/upgrade time, Terraform module updates for offline bundle storage metadata, and a small orchestration helper that validates rollback compatibility before applying upgrades. Design: image-indexer scans a local tarball of mirrored OCI layers or a registry mirror endpoint and emits a compact JSON index keyed by distro profile (ubuntu-20.04 / almalinux-8 / sles-15), kubelet/kernel pairing, and runtime variant (containerd/cri-o). The delta snapshot builder computes diffs against a target bundle and emits a signed snapshot with three sections: additions, removals, and pinned-image-shas. Signatures use the existing installer signing keychain (supports KMS-backed signing). The Helm chart change introduces a new values subtree offline.imageIndex.path and a small initContainer that pulls the indexed manifests into the local registry mirror on first boot. Terraform: module offline-bundles now exposes a metadata.json that contains index version, distro tags and a preflight hash used by the installer to gate upgrades. Rollback safety: the orchestration helper runs a dry-run verification against the index to ensure no required images are missing and that KV cache schema changes are compatible with the target runtime. Notes on security: image index and delta snapshots are signed and verified; index generation validates manifest digests against vendored layers to avoid TOCTOU failures. Backwards compatibility: installer will fall back to previous behavior if offline.imageIndex is not provided. Testing: unit tests for indexer hashing and snapshot diff, integration test that simulates a k3s and rke2 upgrade using vendored images, and an airgap e2e that verifies rollback snapshot application. Rollout checklist: 1) publish new installer binary in release channel, 2) run compatibility sweep on existing customer bundles, 3) communicate upgrade and rollback validation steps to SRE. See linked Linear tasks for follow-up: ENG-2039 (index rotation), ENG-2104 (metric + telemetry), and ENG-2156 (support for bottlerocket).

release_notes: Adds offline image indexing and delta snapshot tooling for the private installer. Enables compact upgrade bundles, signed rollback snapshots, and a Helm init hook to populate local mirrors from index manifests. Backwards compatible when index not supplied.
